name: split-party-firebase
description: Firestore schema tooling for the Split Party PoC: seed, reset, rules, resetDemo function, verification

scripts.test:functions: node scripts/build-functions.js && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-split-party-functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/functions/"
scripts.test:reset-endpoint: node scripts/build-functions.js && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-split-party-endpoint "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/reset-endpoint/*.test.js"
